mapper.select: /*rfc.coway.getPrInterfaceTargetList */ SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER AS BUYER , A.PR_NO AS PR_NO , B.LEGACY_USER_ID AS I_AFNAM , REPLACE(A.PR_NO, 'PR', '30') AS I_MBLNR , CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'X' ELSE 'R' END AS I_STATUS , '' AS I_BDC FROM ICOMPRDT A INNER JOIN COWAY_BYIT C ON ( 1 = 1 AND C.MATNR = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND C.ZCODE = F_SPLIT(NVL(#{if_mg_note }, 'x&x'), '&', 1) AND C.BCODE = F_SPLIT(NVL(#{if_mg_note }, 'x&x'), '&', 2) ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR B ON ( 1 = 1 AND B.USER_ID = NVL(A.PURCHASER_ID, A.ADD_USER_ID) ) WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001', 'KRCOWA0002', 'KRCOWA0003', 'KRCOWA0004', 'KRCOWA0005', 'KRCOWA0006', 'KRCOWA0007', 'KRCOWA0008') AND A.BUYER = #{buyer } AND A.PR_NO = #{prNo } AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM IF_PROGRESS WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND GUBUN = 'XX' AND LEGACY_NO = A.PR_NO AND REMARK = 'ZMM_GSYS_GIREQUEST_CHECK' )

/*rfc.coway.getPrCreateDataList */ SELECT '2000' AS BUKRS , B.DEPARTMENT AS ORGEH , SUBSTRB(C.TEXT1, 1, 40) AS STEXT , D.LEGACY_USER_ID AS PERNR , SUBSTRB(D.USER_NAME_LOC, 1, 40) AS ENAME , D.REG_DATE AS HDATE , D.BLD_2 AS ZGISU , 'N' AS NEWCK , F_SPLIT(A.MG_NOTE, '&', 1) AS ZCODE , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR , SUBSTRB(A.DESCRIPTION, 1, 40) AS MAKTX , A.TARGET_QTY AS GIMENGE , A.UNIT_MEASURE AS MEINS , 'N' AS GUBUN , A.ADD_DATE AS ERSDA , SUBSTRB(A.ADD_USER_NAME, 1, 12) AS ERNAM , A.CHANGE_DATE AS LAEDA , SUBSTRB(A.CHANGE_USER_NAME, 1, 12) AS AENAM , 'N' AS YUMUSANG , 'Y' AS DRSITE , 'C' AS DRCP , '0' AS DPOINT , SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 1, 7) AS POST_CODE1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '리 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '리 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '동 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '동 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '면 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '면 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '읍 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '읍 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '구 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '구 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '군 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '군 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '시 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '시 ') - 7 )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '도 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, 8, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '도 ') - 7 )) END AS CITY1 , CASE WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '리 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '리 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '동 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '동 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '면 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '면 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '읍 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '읍 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '구 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '구 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '군 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '군 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '시 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '시 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) WHEN INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '도 ') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, INSTR(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION, '도 ') + 1, LENGTH(E.DELY_TO_LOCATION) )) END AS STREET , E.CHANGE_USER_TEL AS TEL_NUMBER , '' AS MOB_NUMBER FROM ICOMPRDT A INNER JOIN ICOMPRHD E ON ( 1 = 1 AND E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND E.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR B ON ( 1 = 1 AND B.USER_ID = A.PURCHASER_ID ) INNER JOIN ICOMCOD2 C ON ( 1 = 1 AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND C.COMPANY_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND C.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT AND C.FLAG = 'Y' ) INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR D ON ( 1 = 1 AND D.USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER } AND A.PR_NO = #{PR_NO }
mapper.update: /*rfc.coway.mergeIfProgress */ MERGE INTO IF_PROGRESS A USING (SELECT #{BUYER } AS BUYER , #{PR_NO } AS LEGACY_NO , 'XX' AS GUBUN FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.LEGACY_NO = A.LEGACY_NO AND B.GUBUN = A.GUBUN ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET IF_FLAG = #{IF_FLAG } , ERR_MSG = #{MESSAGE } , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUYER , GUBUN , LEGACY_NO , REVISION , STATUS , REMARK , IF_FLAG , ERR_MSG , TOT_CNT , TOT_AMT , ADD_DATE , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{BUYER } , 'XX' , #{PR_NO } , '0' , 'C' , 'ZMM_GSYS_GIREQUEST_CHECK' , #{IF_FLAG } , #{MESSAGE } , 0 , 0 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') )

/*rfc.coway.insertIcomtrxl */ INSERT INTO ICOMTRXL ( DOC_NAME , TARGET , KEY_1 , KEY_2 , KEY_3 , KEY_4 , KEY_5 , KEY_6 , KEY_7 , KEY_8 , KEY_9 , KEY_10 ) SELECT 'COWAY_PR' , A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.PR_SEQ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , REPLACE(A.PR_NO, 'PR', '20') , ' ' , ' ' , ' ' , ' ' , ' ' , ' ' FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER } AND A.PR_NO = #{PR_NO } AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
